title: Every document was a copy of the last one

items.value: Every document was a copy of the last one

Devi Logistics was running a freight forwarding business out of spreadsheets. Every quotation, every invoice, every bill of lading was an Excel file, copied from the last one, edited by hand, saved somewhere, then attached to an email.
It works until it does not. Files drift out of sync. Numbering breaks. Somebody edits the wrong copy. Answering what does this customer still owe us means opening six files and adding it up.

And none of it could be done away from the desk, so a quote requested on a Friday evening waited until Monday morning. For a growing forwarder that admin layer quietly becomes the ceiling. Not because the work is not there, but because nobody has time to document it.

title: The desk stopped being the bottleneck.

items.value: The desk stopped being the bottleneck.
A quote can now go out from a warehouse, an airport or a customer's office, minutes after the conversation that prompted it.
The portal runs properly on phone and tablet, not as a cut down mobile view, so the same document can be created and sent from anywhere.
Super optimised. We can create a document and send it to a customer straight from the phone.
Can you build custom software for a small freight forwarder?
Yes. This portal was built for exactly that size of operator. Serious enough to need proper documentation, too lean to carry a back office team or a heavy enterprise system.
Can it generate bills of lading and invoices as PDFs?
Yes. Quotations, invoices and shipping documents come out as clean PDFs, ready to send to the customer without reformatting.
Will it work on a phone?
Yes. The full portal is built for phone and tablet, so a quote or an invoice can be created and sent away from the office.
